conversations: Who am I? Where is this?
You are finally awaken. This is Seireitei,  but you need to find out for yourself who you are.
Searching for the true me?
It's you! You are finally awaken.
You know me? Then who am I?
Captain Commander Yamamoto brought you back from the battlefield. No one knows who you are!
Aizen! I suddenly remember fighting this guy. Who is this?
Did you remember anything?
Join the battle and see if you can remember anything.
(Next day…in the Captain Commander's Office) I have a task I need you to finish.
Sure,  it's time for me to go out.
13th Division Lieutenant Rukia Kuchiki has stayed in Human World and not return. Go and investigate about this.
Yes,  sir.
Senkaimon..this is the right direction.
Isn't this $fb0735#playername#$? Where are you going?
Captain Kyōraku,  Commander Yamamoto gives me a task. I'm leaving now! (Enters Senkaimon)
This is the Dangai. What the heck is that? (Just as you enter Dangai,  you discovered something floating pass)
This is the Human World? The Reiatsu is so weak.
Hey! You can see the little girl right.
I'll take care of this. (Who is this dude? Why can he see my Shinigami form?)
Urahara Shop…This must be it. Anyone here?
You are finally here. Soul Society sends some $fb0735weapons$,  you can wear it $fb0735to increase battle power$!
I just met a dude who can see my Shinigami form,  can you help me investigate?
No problem. I'll let you know as soon as possible.
$fb0735#playername#$,  you are now a middle school student and you'll report tomorrow to school!
Why do I need to go to middle school?
Don't worry about these details. The dude is also at this school.
My head hurts! (You start gaining more memory! )
(In your memory) $fb0735#playername#$,  do you have a heart? Let me see your heart!
Ah…
Isn't this Ganju? It must be your sister who wants you to follow me. You are so weak,  what can you do? !
Don't underestimate me! You can place me in $fb0735 the formation's Vanguard$ position. I can help you $fb0735block enemies' damages.$
Oh,  a tank. You can follow me to school.
You are also a Shinigami! Why are you here? (It feels terrible to be blocked just as you enter the school.)
You are also a Shinigami then! Are you Rukia Kuchiki? Go back to Seireitei with me.
My capabilities are not yet recovered. Once I'm completely recovered,  I'll go back. But I have a favor to ask. Can you help me?
Help you? Do I get anything in return?
I have some $fb0735equipment$. You can $fb0735wear it to protect yourself from enemies' damages$. You can take it.
Sure,  what do you want me to do?
In the process of rescuing,  I gave my power to Ichigo Kurosaki. I hope you can look after him for me!
No problem. I was just wondering why he can see me.
(After one night) Ichigo,  follow me,  there is an assignment.
You? Why are you following me?
I'm helping Rukia. Let's go to Inoue Home,  there is some problem!
Rukia,  we solve the problem. I got this by the Hollow. Can you take a look?
This should be the $fb0735Soul Map$! When you use $fb0735souls to upgrade$,  you'll get the spirit's power! Your $fb0735battle power will greatly increase$,  and you can get $fb0735your own skills$!
Sounds good. But how I do get souls?
When you $fb0735defeat the enemies for the first time,  you can get some souls$! Let's return.
(A few days later…) Ichigo,  I just a saw a Hollow pretending to be a little girl! Too bad he ran away!
Pretending to be a person? Where? (Ichigo suddenly remembers something and asks)
It is at the graveyard on the west side! Don't go! Wait for me! (Even before you finish talking,  Ichigo Kurosaki charge out)
Why are you such hot-blooded over such weaklings?
6 years ago,  I was here with my mother! But this hollow killed my mother. 6 years! I finally got my chance!
It's time to look forward to the future.
It's time for us to return. The others must be worried! Let's go!
It seems the Denreishinki is broken. It rings but no hollow!
Just kill the hollow when we see it,  and if not,  it's a good exercise anyway!
(At this time,  Denreishinki rings again) Go call Ichigo,  it's in the northwest direction! Let's go!
Where is the hollow?
Who's there? (You feel the Reiatsu around you changing)
It seems you guys don't know me. My name is Uryū Ishida. I'm a Quincy!
Shinigami and Quincy are sworn enemies. Since you guys found me,  let's have a duel!
Uryū Ishida is a Quincy? I hate these pointless battles!
Uryū Ishida is our classmate. I didn't know he is a Quincy.
Same class? I never notice him before.
He's an excellent student.(Looking at Ichigo's surprise expression,  you feel helpless)
I feel that your Reiatsu decreasing as you battle. Did you notice?
After I wake up,  my Reiatsu starts decreasing.
You forgot to cultivate it. Go and cultivate Reiatsu! $fb0735Cultivating your Reiatsu will increase your overall battle power$!
How does it feel?
I don't feel any difference.  I must battle to try it out.
$fb0735You will truly feel the power of your Reiatsu while battling others$!
Something is wrong,  the Reiatsu in the air keeps changing!
I feel nervous also. You can stay here while I go and take a look.
I seem to have met him before. He is holding on to Ichigo's sister! Let go! (You suddenly see a big guy holding Ichigo's sister)
What am I feeling? I think I hit it? (The big guy swings and punches toward a certain direction)
This is not a normal person right? Then I'm going to charge.
What the heck are you doing?! You don't know Yasutora Sado!
Yasutora Sado? Who is that? (Looks confusingly at Rukia)
Rukia... (Finish speakings and faint)
$fb0735#playername#$, Denreishinki shows that many hollows are appearing at school! You go to help. I'm going to another location.
Inoue! Inoue is still at school!
I'm going first,  you are in charge here!
$fb0735#playername#$,  look at my power: Shun Shun Rikka. I'm sure my brother gave this to me!
Yes! (After battling,  you look at Inoue's new power and praise her!) Who's the guy on the side? You can come out now.
I'm Izuru Kira. Captain Commander sends me to help you. You just need to place me $fb0735 in the Assault position to deal damage$,  I'll kill all the enemies!
You can follow me,  but don't tell anyone in Seireitei about what's going on here!
Rukia,  what happened? (After dealing with the things at School,  you rush to Rukia)
Ichigo the idiot decides to battle Uryū Ishida!
Everything is fine now. Don't worry!
I'm leaving now. The Urahara Shop's owner is looking for me!
Oh,  please help me pick up the things I bought from his shop.
Sure! Izuru Kira,  I got this Experience Scroll from Urahara,  it can upgrade your Level!
Thank you.
Hey,  Urahara! Rukia wants me to help her bring her stuff back!
Go pick it up in the warehouse,  it’s the box near the entrance!
What the heck is this? Urahara,  I'm leaving now!
Did you get the stuff back?
This is it. (Then you throw the item to Rukia)
Why did I get this? Oh well…
Ichigo! Eat this! This is a Gikongan! When your soul is not in your body,  the Gikongan will control your body!
Is it truly that great? I'll try...
Eat it now! Hollows are appearing again! (Looking at the confused Ichigo,  Rukia stuff the Gikongan into Ichigo's mouth)
Don't worry when you are out,  I'll take care of things here! (As soon as Ichigo's soul left his body,  the Gikongan takes over Ichigo's body)
(Few hours later...) Ichigo,  I heard the Gikongan use your body to flirt with the girls in the class!
Damn it! Help me get it back!
Just give up on it! If you get the body back,  will you be able to face the girls in class? Your dead!
Help me get it back!
Ichigo,  what do you plan on to do after you find it?
I haven't thought about it! Find it first!
It should be in approximately that way…
Hey! $fb0735#playername#$,  if I place it in other things,  what will it be like?
I don't know. Why don't you try?
Place it in here! (Ichigo saw an old stuff lion by the trash pile)
Hey! It actually moves! Wait,  we shouldn't be worried about this right now. Ichigo,  how are you going to deal with the girls in your class. Don't go!
(Few days later) $fb0735#playername#$, where is Rukia? She's staying in the Human World for so long, the Central 46 gives order to capture Rukia!
Isn't this Byakuya? How do you have time to come to the human world?
Seems like you will not tell me, then I'll find her myself. (He left.)
You are always so anxious. I'll tag along to make sure nothing bad happens.
(When you arrive, you find Ichigo lying on the floor and the power slowly leaving his body) Byakuya, you went a bit too far!
You are going to block me?
Okay, we can also see if I improved.
Isn't this Leiutenant Izuru Kira? What happen to you? (After Byakuya left, another person appears)
Yumichika!
It seems you guys need us to help you battle. If you want to hire me, come and find me in the $fb0735tavern$
(This dude looks quite good. It seems like I should make a trip to the Tavern)
You are finally here. After Ichigo got hurt and I brought him back, his Shinigami power disappears!
Byakuya is so heartless.
I know how to help him get it back. Can you find him for me?
Ichigo, are you depressed?
What are you doing here? I lost my power and cannot help you anymore.
You have a temper! Urahara says he can help you recover your Shinigami power. It's up to you if you want to go or not.
Urahara just taught me something good - $fb0735fortifying equipment$.  After $fb0735fortifying, my battle power will increase$ again.
You are here.
I'm just a messenger.
Can you recover my power? (Ichigo looks confusingly at Urahara)
It's simple. First, you have to pass my test. You need to hit me in one move.
You actually did it! Now, let's start with the second phase.
Second phase? What do you mean?
Every Shinigami's Zanpakutō has a name. Zanpakutō hides the name in its heart. You need to find out your Zanpakutō's name!
Ask Zanpakutō's name?
Now I'm going to cut your Chain of Fate. If by the time the Chain of Fate disappears and you did not find the name, you'll become a hollow!
Become a hollow! (Urahara cut Ichigo's Chain of Fate in one move.)
Now I'm going to throw you down! (He throws Ichigo into a giant hole in the ground)
$fb0735#playername#$, use your Zanpakutō's power and enter into Ichigo's internal world to help him!
Why me?
I need to prepare the passageway to Soul Society. Go now!
Fine, it's not the first time anyway.
What's happening?
With my help, of course it will be successful.
(Suddenly, an explosion in the hole) Zangetsu!
You did it.
Now that you have recovered your Shinigami's power, it's time for you guys to go!
Not just the two of us?
Your friends want to come along and I can't stop them. Now I'm going to open the path.
Go! When you reach Dangai, be careful of Kōtotsu! (Looking at the Garganta, you guys step in directly)
This is Garganta?
It feels weird.
Something is behind us…
It's a Kōtotsu! You guys go, I'll deal with it.
Finally, we're here.
This is the Soul Society, then it's where the Shinigami lives? (Ichigo starts running, but something falls from the sky and blocks the path)
You guys dare to tresspass without the permits. I'll treat you nicely.
You can attack anywhere. (The guy raises his axe)
Oh, it's you, $fb0735#playername#$.
Sorry for not reminding you earlier.
$fb0735Your girlfriend at home is anxiously waiting for you!

My $fb0735Lucky Cat should be full. Go pick it up$! Remember to go pick the the $fb0735Partying with Girlfriend and Interchange Rewrads$. If you are missing a servants, remember to use the $fb0735Master & Slave Function$ to catch a slave. Now open the gate for us.
What's happening? Why are you suddenly quiet?
(Suddenly a blade flashes and Jidanbō Ikkanzaka's arms are hurt by the blade. The Hakutōmon also falls heavily on Jidanbō Ikkanzaka's shoulders)
Jidanbō Ikkanzaka!
How can you hurt someone who is defenseless at the moment? (Ichigo charges toward the guy)
Ichigo, be careful!
Why are you standing so far away? Do you want to throw the blade at us also? (Ichigo looks confusingly at Gin)
This is not a normal blade, it's my Zanpakutō! (The blade flies and knocks the two of them out of Hakutōmon! )
Bye bye! (Gin smirks at you guys as he looks at through the gate)
Ganju, what are you doing here?
I received orders from my sister so I came back.
Why are there other Shinigami here? (Ganju took of his goggles and look at Ichigo)
Let's duel! (Ganju charge at Ichigo)
Time for us to keep moving! I wonder why Ganju suddenly left..(The next day, the cat suddenly talks)
Mr. Yoruichi? I want to wait for that guy and battle him first!
What the heck are you talking about? Let's go! (Knocks Ichigo to the ground)
You should go to your $fb0735Home and upgrade your Home and girlfriend$, that way $fb0735your girlfriend will give you more things$.
Where are we going next?
We're going to try to find a way to enter into Seireitei.
Isn't this Kūkaku's home?
Yes, we'll use Kūkaku's cannon to enter!
Look outside! (Next day, through Reishūkaku you guys become Spirit Bullet and Kūkaku use the cannon to shoot you guys into Seireitei)
This is Seireitei. (Finally you guys fly into the air above Seireitei)
We're going to crash! (Kūkaku requires that Ganju to join your group)
Everybody, put your spirit into the Reishūkaku! (The Reishūkaku entered into Seireitei, but it suddenly breaks and everyone lands separately within Seireitei)
That must be the Arena! (Everyone lands separately, you, Ichigo and Ganju land close to the Arena)
What's the use of Arena?
$fb0735Arena$, $fb0735you can win in the Arena and get prestige to upgrade your rank$. $fb0735Your rank also receives salary once per day$.
Go and try!
How was it?
This is the place for Shinigami to practice fighting
You'll benefit from visiting Arena regularly.
We need to keep going if we want to rescue Rukia.
Look at those delicious prey! I'm so lucky! (Suddenly a bald-headed guy appears)
I'll attract his attention, you guys keep going but remember to come back and rescue me! (Then Ganju runs away)
Hey! Why don't you guys run away? Did the guy just ran away because he thinks he can't beat us?
If you guys are not that tough to beat, then we'll beat you first before progressing! (Ichigo pull his blade out)
Such bad luck…
I want to ask you a question! I want to know where is Rukia Kuchiki>
Go south from here and you'll see the offices of Gotei 13. On the west side is a white tower, she's probably locked in there.
You must be the most powerful in your team. Be careful of my captain, if you can survive him…
Ganju, are you okay?
You are an idiot, your partner is also an idiot! You both came to die! (Yumichika taunts Ganju)
Yumichika, can't you just let us pass?
No way, the 11th Division is the most powerful battle division! Let's start!
I know where Rukia is at! Let's go!
Oh, okay.
Wait, I have to go to $fb0735Arena$ and defeat someone so I can $fb0735catch a slave for my Home$!
Go quickly!
We're trapped! (The group was surrounded by the 11th Division)
Hey, I know how to escape!
I thought so too, let's go!
Get out of our way! (Ganju screams at the surrounding people! )
(Ichigo capture a Shinigami outside and puts his sword by his throat)
If you don't want your partners to get hurt, move away!
It seems that they don't care. Let's run!
Look, that must be the Senzaikyū!
Wait! Someone is on the steps!
Long time no see, do you still remember me?
I would like to forget you, but I have many things I want to take back from you, Renji Abarai!
I thought you would die under Captain Kuchiki's attack. Even though I don't know how you survived, but you are worthy of praise.
$fb0735#playername#$, battle is over! Let's go!
Let me finish my Daily Tasks first!
Daily Tasks? What's the use?

$fb0735Daily Tasks means you need to finish the tasks for the day. You can randomly select tasks, but if you finish the designated task, your task bar will progress greatly. If your total tasks points can reach the target, you'll also get abundant reward$! Let me finish first!
What's this?! Such a powerful Reiatsu!
Let's run before the enemy discover us!
They are here…So which one is it that I'm looking for? (The person was on the rooftop and looking down)
What? You didn't hear about me from Ikkaku? I'm 11th Division Captain, Kenpachi Zaraki. I'm here to challenge you!
$fb0735#playername#$, you can go first and leave him to me! (In the midst of battling, Ichigo suddenly talks)
Sure, I'm going to ask Captain Commander about this!
Go! (Ichigo charges toward Kenpachi Zaraki)
Renji Abarai?! (In the process of going to Captain Commander's place, you guys met Renji Abarai who was healed by the 4th Division)

I am really a tramp down to my bones. I hate myself. I bark at the moon, but I don't have the courage to jump and grab it! Fighting to get Rukia back is nothing but an impossible dream to me. Kurosaki, I'm probably shameless for doing this, but I have to ask you. Please, you have to save Rukia!
I'll save Rukia for sure!
Thank you! (Then Renji faints)
Captain Commander…(You finally reached Captain Commander)
So you're back…let's fight!
Captain Commander, we came to beg you to release Rukia. I did not came to fight you.
Did you know that the Ryoka you brought killed the 5th Division Captain?
Captain Commander, we did not kill the 5th Division Captain!
Prove to me!
Please tell me how.
Go to the $fb0735Trial Tower and find the suspect, then kill it as a prove. If afterwards you are right, we will give you some reward$!
It seems Captain Commander is letting us do what we want to do!
Senzaikyū's guard are changing guard. Let's try to get the key! (After leaving Captain Commander on your way to Ichigo, you suddenly find out Senzaikyū's guards are changing guard)
Hey, Ganju! (After you got Senzaikyū's keys, you suddenly see Ganju.)
Why are you here?
This is Senzaikyū's key! You can go rescue Rukia, I'll go help Ichigo!
Okay, trust me on this.
Yoruichi, why are you here?! (You reach Ichigo and discover Yoruichi hiding nearby)
Shhh...Ichigo is talking to his inner Zanpakutō. I heard you have good Zanpakutō ability, go help!
Again!
Go now!
Yoruichi, what should we do now?
Wait! (Yoruichi slowly changes back to a human)
Yoruichi, can you put on your clothes properly?
I'm done now.
Oh, you're back. That's great them, let's go together.
Sorry.
What's to be sorry about? You won...(After speaking, Kenpachi falls to the ground)
Now you guys are qualified to enter $fb0735Soul Hunt! Find the target and you'll get great rewards$!
Ganju, sorry we're late! Byakuya Kuchiki! (After you guys reach Senzaikyū, you suddenly discover Byakuya is battling Ganju)
Since you guys are all here, then let's get this over with!
Byakuya, you cannot kill them now! (Yoruichi picks you and Ichigo up)
I'm taking them with me. You can try to catch me, but I don't think you'll be able to.
Next, I'm going to help you train Bankai. If you can reach Bankai, your battle power will improve by 10 times, but you only have 3 days!
If I can't do it in 3 days…
No one knows the result. You want to join us?
Me? I don't need it, in my memory I know Bankai.
Ichigo, then let's start.
I can feel Uryū's Reiatsu in the midst of battle.
You can go help him.
Uryū! Are you okay?
I'm okay (then he falls to the ground)
I'll take care of you.
Uryū Ishida, I'm taking you to Captain Unohana!
Captain Unohana, my friend is hurt. Can you help heal him?
I can heal him, but you owe me one.
Yes, thank you so much, Captain Unohana. I'm going to go now.
Renji, are you healed already? (When you return to Ichigo's training place, Renji arrives)
I'm fine. I'm here to pass a message: Rukia will be executed in 3 days…
What? Okay.
Who's hiding over there? Come out!
Hum, you're brave. I hope your braveness and your capabilities are the same.
My power? Let's try it.
Let me see what you got.
(After a fierce battle, the hollow looks at you) I guess I underestimate you.
So weak and you dare to challenge me.
Don't be so rude, I'm just a shadow. My original form is waiting to challenge you.
Original form?
$fb0735You can challenge my original form everyday at 11:59 AM$! If you can defeat it, you'll get abundant reward!
Time to leave…we'll almost there..(We're going to rescue you now, Rukia! We won't let you die! )
I'm going to join you also!
This Reiatsu is…Captain Kuchiki! (On your way to Sōkyoku Hill, you suddenly feel a strong Reiatsu and see Byakuya Kuchiki standing on the roof top in front of you! )
Where are you going, Renji? (Just as he finished talking, he appears right in fornt of you)
I can capture your moves already. Your sword won't be able to kill me! (Renji turns and use the Zanpakutō to attack Byakuya)
What the heck are you talking about? You really think you can defeat me with this power…

$fb0735#playername#$, Evil Spirits will be here soon. Go and block them! $fb0735You can click on Daily Activities to see the events$. $fb0735Evil Spirits events will give you abundant experiences and silver$! $fb0735Guild War can showcase the Guild's power$, and the $fb0735Ryokas will attack Seireitei$!
Are you guys done talking? Now, it's my turn!
We're finally at Sōkyoku Hill. Rukia, we're coming!
$fb0735#playername#$, we're here!
Inoue! Yasutora Sado! Uryū Ishida! You guys are all here?
Ichigo will be here soon! Let's go for Rukia!!
That yellow hair weirdo called to invite you to join their Guild.
What's the benefit of joining his Guild?

After you join a $fb0735Guild, you can donate to get merits$, $fb0735and use the merits to upgrade Guild skills$! As part of a guild, you can join $fb0735Guild War and Protect Seireitei$, Captain Commander will give out Guild reward!
Tell him I'm not joining his Guild. I'm going to create a guild of my own!
Hey, Rukia...(You guys finally reached Sōkyoku Hill and saw the bounded Rukia)
Everyone…is here...(Rukia was so moved that she broke down in tears! )
For the promise, for our partners, we're here!
I'll not let you guys interrupt the execution! (Suddenly, a fat guy appears and blocks everyone)
Ichigo…you are finally here!
Inoue, Chad and Uryū, you guys take Rukia and leave here now!
Trial Tower is developed by Kisuke Urahara when he was at Division 12 as a $fb0735cultivation area$!  You can get $fb0735Hōgu$ there. $fb0735Hōgu will greatly increase your battle power!
That's great! I'll go try it now!

Kisuke Urahara just delivered a tool to you. $fb0735Virtual Instance Path$ help you get some experiences. You $fb0735can get equipment materials and experiences when you pass through these Virtual Instance Path!$
Why is Urahara helping me so much? Is he using me as test type? Let's go and see.
What's the use of these materials?

Urahara said you can use take these materials and find $fb0735Hachigen Ushōda to forge them to equipment$, $fb0735equipment quality will be the same as the material's quality$, and $fb0735the equipment also comes with Spirit Stones holes$!
Spirit Stones holes? What's the use?

$fb0735Spirit Stones holes are for embedding Spirit Stones$! After you obtained $fb0735Spirit Stones, you can find Nemu Kurotsuchi$ and asked her to use the 11th Division technology to $fb0735embed Spirit Stones on the equipments$! You can get Spirit Stones in the $fb0735Ryoka Attack activity, or you can purchase them in the Shop$!
Brother, what happened?
Are we late? Ichigo, charge!
Don't worry, look at me!
$fb0735#playername#$, you're here! How did you get hurt?
I hurt myself earlier.
Let me heal you. I just learn my healing power!
